title: -mente --- With No Upper Limit
label: ch:friend-mente
canDo: I can build an adverb from any adjective, and say why the adjective goes feminine first.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C56-mente: build rapidamente, explain the feminine step, and say what the word literally means.
payoff.note: A machine rather than a decoder: its reach is however many adjectives the reader ends up holding. The feminine step is not arbitrary -- mente was a feminine NOUN, and the agreement outlived it.
